tasks.subject: Phase 1: Operational cleanup
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rotate shared dev credentials and mark seed credentials as local-only.
**Acceptance Criteria:** Dev account passwords changed by the user via direct DB update; Neon password rotated in GitHub and Render; README states seed credentials are local-only. Agent-side cleanup of local notes and scripts is done.
**Verify:** User confirms rotation; old credential rejected by POST /auth/login on dev.
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "mechanical", "userGate": true, "acceptanceCriteria": ["Dev passwords rotated", "Neon password rotated", "README note added"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 2: Roles and access
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Enforce roles and tighten cross-user access.
**Acceptance Criteria:** RolesGuard + @Roles; publishing admin-only; admin can edit, unpublish and delete any template; non-admins cannot edit published templates; GET /users/:id self-or-admin; created_by null for non-owner non-admin viewers; leaderboard user_id replaced by is_me; users.disabled_at with admin disable/enable, enforced on login, JWT and sockets; scripts/promote-admin.ts; cross-user e2e matrix; schema doc and migration.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Non-admin publish returns 403", "Admin moderation works", "Cross-user matrix passes", "Disabled user is rejected"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Email identity
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Unique normalized email, email verification, password reset and change via Resend.
**Acceptance Criteria:** EMAIL_SENDER port and Resend adapter; RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, APP_BASE_URL required on staging/production only; normalizeEmail in register, login and forgot-password; migration lowercases emails, adds CHECK, aborts on collision without merging; users.email_verified_at backfilled for existing users; users.token_version in JWT, checked by JwtStrategy and gateway; auth_tokens table storing SHA-256 hashes only, single use, reset 1h, verification 24h, one send per account per 5 minutes; POST /auth/forgot-password (uniform 202, async send), /auth/reset-password (sets email_verified_at, invalidates tokens and sessions), /auth/change-password (requires current password), /auth/verify-email, /auth/resend-verification; register returns uniform 202; unverified users get 403 on AI, connectors and planning jobs; tokens in URL fragment and POST body only; audit events; frontend guide updated. Requires user to create the Resend account and verify a domain.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e; then real mail test on dev to a user-controlled inbox.
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Case variants collide", "Uniform forgot-password response", "Expired, reused and tampered tokens rejected", "Reset ends old sessions", "Only hashes stored", "Unverified users blocked from AI, connectors and planning"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 4: Limits
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Bound input sizes, responses, AI use and storage per user.
**Acceptance Criteria:** @MaxLength and ArrayMaxSize across DTOs (must accept the existing 17-section template); capped pagination on GET /templates; per-user daily AI quota in Redis, failing closed for AI only; per-user caps on documents, sections per document, versions, templates; scope enum with global admin-only; doc_type validated; leaderboard XP capped per day. Needs user decision on quota numbers first.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Oversized input rejected", "Pagination capped", "Quota enforced", "Caps enforced"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 5: Auth hardening
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Finish session and login hardening.
**Acceptance Criteria:** Sockets disconnected at token expiry; logout bumps token_version; per-account login throttle; dummy bcrypt compare for unknown emails; boot fails on staging/production if CORS is * or JWT_SECRET equals the .env.example placeholder; password capped at 72 bytes.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Socket ends at expiry", "Logout invalidates token", "Login throttled per account", "Unsafe production config fails boot"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 6: Remaining items
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Close the remaining smaller items.
**Acceptance Criteria:** Audit events for template publish, update, delete, admin actions and role changes; per-tier broker credentials with restricted queue permissions and trust boundary documented in docs/security.md; Swagger off on staging; generic provider errors to clients; featureType allowlist; doc-type check on apply; connector reconnect reviewed for leftover Composio accounts and fixed if needed; Postgres TLS verifies the server certificate (typeorm data source and app config currently use rejectUnauthorized false), confirming Neon CA compatibility; non-admin template update made conditional on is_published at the DB so a concurrent publish can't be overwritten.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Audit events recorded", "Swagger off on staging", "Provider errors generic", "Connector reconnect resolved"]}
```
